inputs.stripped: The same corpus files after metaflac --remove-all --dont-use-padding, so frame-level checks run; 165 of 171 could be stripped.

method.host: AMD EPYC 7313P, shared development host, SMT enabled
method.order: Alternate first revision on each pair; all 40 fresh-process trials retained, no warmups or retries.
method.timed: First measure() call, including pool initialization; file I/O and JSON serialization excluded.
method.note: Not the c7i.4xlarge used for the previous migration. A separate 12-pair rerun of s24_96k_240s.flac gave best 0.3004 s before and 0.3676 s after (+22.4%).
